status: frozen metadata-only MAST search before query
scope: public WFC3/IR calibration DARK ramps near two current science visits; no image pixels, no FITS science downloads, no noise outcomes
tier_rule: query ±30 days for each visit; widen that visit to ±180 only if fewer than four exact metadata-eligible DARK/SPARS50/full-frame/NSAMP>=8 public roots
fallback: if target_name wildcard returns no observations in a visit, repeat once without target_name and inspect calibration targets only; do not infer target from image data
read_pattern_gate: SPARS50 and NSAMP>=8; NSAMP>8 only first-eight-prefix conditional on matching exact per-read timing/zero convention
ranking: absolute EXPSTART distance from corresponding science visit, then rootname; 4–8 repeated same-layout candidates per visit if available; no signal/noise ranking
products: metadata list and HTTP Range FITS headers only for nearest candidates, RAW preferred and IMA availability logged; no FITS science bytes
interpretation: RAW pairs preferred for future work; IMA/FLT may reuse DARKFILE trained on selected darks, so not independent master-dark validation; no actual covariance measured
